description: Source code for nsRemoteDebuggingPipe class implementing inter-thread communication and platform-specific pipe handling in Mozilla Firefox.

classes.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe
classes.description: Implements a platform-specific pipe for remote debugging communication in Mozilla Firefox.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the pipe, handling platform differences.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bytes to the pipe, handling platform differences.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::GetSingleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of nsRemoteDebuggingPipe.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::Init
methods.description: Initializes the pipe with a client and sets up reader and writer threads.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::Stop
methods.description: Stops the pipe, shutting down threads and closing handles.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::ReaderLoop
methods.description: Continuously reads data from the pipe, dispatching messages to the main thread.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages received from the pipe.

methods.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe::SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the pipe to the remote client.
